description: Angular component for managing documentation links within the Thingsboard UI, including form handling, editing, adding, and event emission.

classes.name: DocLinkComponent
classes.description: Angular component for creating, editing, and deleting documentation links with form validation and event handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets addMode based on addOnly input.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if the form control is in an error state for validation display.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form model.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on the input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with a given DocumentationLink value and manages addMode state.

methods.name: switchToEditMode
methods.description: Enables editing mode if not disabled.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Validates and applies the form data, emitting update events.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new documentation link if form is valid.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Emits delete event for the documentation link.

methods.name: isEditing
methods.description: Returns true if in edit or add mode.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the internal model and propagates change if form is valid.
